stories.title: Medical Tests, Microbiology Top Research Schedule Aboard Station
stories.summary: Medical tests and microbiology topped the research schedule for the Expedition 74 crew aboard the International Space Station on Tuesday. The seven crewmates also worked on spacesuits, cargo operations, and life support maintenance.
